strings.en: Is that true!? Kamille?
Y-yes. That big Zaku-headed mobile armor...
I think they called it the Apsaras Project,
and the name of the Zeon official in charge was...
Ginias Sahalin...!?
Huh, what's wrong?
Well, when I escaped the Jaburo facility, I intercepted Zeon comms...
and apparently a name I happened to hear belongs to
someone Lieutenant Amada knows.
Someone he knows? Who?
...Kamille, report this to Commander Hazuki.
We might be able to find the base of Zeon's ground forces...!
Understood.
Oh, Kamille, I'll come too.
Lieutenant Amada...?
...Ginias Sahalin... the same surname as Aina...
This is it. The spot Garrison mentioned...
A string of disappearances around here...
But in the middle of a war, what are we even doing here?
Who knows. But they said this mission came from Banjo.
As his assistants, we have to do what the boss says.
Why doesn't Banjo go himself?
Honestly, he just couldn't be bothered, I bet.
Huh? But Big Bro Banjo said something about the Daitarn...
...After the last battle on Mars, under pressure from the Federation,
the Daitarn was scrapped. You were there, weren't you?
He blew it up in style, didn't he. Ah...! Reika, Toppo!
I see it, a suspicious building!
Where, where... Whoa!
Toppo!? ...Ahh!
So, here you were...
Hahaha... Magnificent! Truly, truly magnificent...
With your power, this Earth will...
Now I must do something about the one inside.
This old body of mine cannot take his place...
That one is needed after all...
Glad you've all gathered. I want to explain our next moves.
How's the war going?
Well, I made contact with Captain Bright.
In space... the fight against the Vega Star Federation and Gaizok goes on.
Hey, for all that, they never come down to Earth.
Yeah, true, Big Bro. Never seen 'em.
Partly because Londo Bell is holding an absolute defense line,
but we can't see what they're after.
Anyway, they don't seem intent on descending to Earth to do anything.
Seems like they're probing for something. For what, I don't know...
Hold on. But Za Boom and the Bunker, was it?
They came down, didn't they?
Because those groups have warp drive. Even we can't stop that.
Warp drive, huh. Wish we had something that handy.
Straight to the enemy's base in one jump.
True, however great the Gandor is, there's nothing it can do about that.
A different level of civilization, then.
For now we're holding our own, but who knows how it'll go...
Warp, huh. Doesn't really click for me.
Hey, Princess Romina? The Elshank has one, right?
Oh, yes. You mean wormhole navigation.
Short-range warps we call micro-worm navigation.
Princess. This is hard to say at such a time, but...
What is it, Gameran? Is something troubling you?
Yes. The Elshank's fuel is about to run dry...
Then the Elshank won't be able to move?
Not right away... but eventually.
Hold on. Can't we just get resupplied somewhere?
This is why barbarians are such trouble.
What'd you say!
The Elshank runs on a special substance
called Kirhasium.
Resupply? As if such a thing exists on Earth!
Grr...
Kirhasium does exist on Earth.
What!?
However, with Earth's current science, Kirhasium
can't be fully refined...
Is there nothing that can be done? Commander Hazuki?
We do have Photon Power energy, but...
Couldn't that do the trick?
We've got Photon Power energy, if that'd work...
I doubt it can substitute.
How long will the fuel last?
For a while, it'll be fine.
I have an idea. We may be able to obtain some.
Is that true!? Commander Hazuki.
Yes. However, the Gandor Team is mid-operation.
We'll put our current mission first for now... Is that acceptable?
You sure? It's not gonna run out of gas and stall on us, is it?
"Out of gas" sounds kinda weird somehow...
Geez, who cares about that.
Thank you... Commander Hazuki. We cause you nothing but trouble...
No need to be so formal. Please raise your head, Princess Romina.
Kyahaha! Kotaro's flustered, he's flustered!
Cham! Don't tease! And don't call the Commander by his first name.
...Honestly, who knows what Fujiwara or Yuki would say if they saw this...
Also, bad news. ...That mystery enemy has turned up in space too.
What!?
So it's not just a ground force? Then where are they coming from?
...I honestly have no idea what's going on.
For now, all we can do is crush what we can see, one at a time.
Commander... about Zeon's secret base...
There's that too... Kamille's info let us roughly pinpoint it.
The mountains of Southeast Asia look suspicious.
Commander Hazuki! Emergency transmission!
What is it?
Over New York...
a force thought to be those Aura Battlers has appeared...!
What!?
Did Drake open the Aura Road!?
And also... in the desert of the Central Asia region...
a direct military SOS went out... and vanished at once!
Another full plate... Gimme a break.
Right, Gandor, launch. Everyone, return to your stations!
See? It was a girl's voice, right?
Yeah, but others besides me heard her voice too.
Huh? Really? What's that mean? I thought only we could hear?
No idea... That may be true of the Einst voices,
but that girl's voice, others seem to hear it sometimes too.
So maybe she's talking so we'll hear on purpose...
Not that I get it...
And why does she know about me?
I'd like to know that myself! Nothing makes any sense.
Right... We'll run into her again eventually... but it bugs me...
You've got me, and you're worried about that girl!?
That's not it.
Kidding...
Anyway, Alchemie... I feel like I know her somehow.
Yeah... I had that feeling too...
Oh, I need to get ready to sortie soon...
Got it... I'll call if I learn anything... Later.
Hey...! Geez! I'm about to sortie, and he can't even say
something a little sweet...
